capabilities: Open a view listing all notes included in a selected MOC
Add or remove up links in the frontmatter of included notes
Find notes whose up link points to the MOC but are not included in it
Insert missing notes as links at the cursor position
Filter notes by selection in the MOC text to link only some of them
extras: Desktop only; the README states it cannot be used on mobile. Bug reports are requested via an issue tracker (link removed from the text).
problem: Keeping a MOC and its children's up links in sync is manual and error-prone, so notes end up missing from the MOC or lacking an up link.
summary: Adds views and commands for maintaining up links between child notes and Map of Content (MOC) notes.
